data.name: PlanetOrbit
data.detailed_description:
A small spherical planet, all to yourself.

The ground is dry, there are no lights, and nobody comes here.

Your job is to turn it into a neon-lit casino planet.

EARN - Take a seat at the table

Chips are won at the casino in one corner of your planet.

  • Poker

  • Baccarat

  • Blackjack

  • Chinchiro (Japanese dice game)

  • Roulette

  • Slots

When to push and when to fold is up to you. Win big, and the face of your planet changes that same night.

BUILD - Decorate your planet

Spend your chips on buildings and place them anywhere you like. The surface is a sphere, so nothing is ever tucked away around the back.

Walk the ground and set them down as you go, or switch to the overhead camera and shape the whole planet at a glance.

GROW - The planet answers back

The more you build, the more the planet changes. Grass sprouts from the dry ground, trees rise, and water fills the hollows.

And drawn by the lights, NPCs begin to visit.

PLAY - On your own, or with others

You can sit down at the same table online and play against other players.

Out of chips? You are never stuck

If you lose everything at the tables, the "Work Room" on the right of the screen always earns you a small amount of chips. You can rebuild and get back to it at any time.

Disclaimer (Please Read) This title is a casino-themed simulation game and contains absolutely no real-money gambling elements. The chips earned and used in the game are a fictional currency valid only within the game; it is impossible to wager real money or exchange them for cash, cryptocurrency, or any other real-world value.

Streaming & Video Guidelines

You are welcome to stream and make videos of this game. No prior permission is required.

  • Monetization OK (ads, donations, memberships)

  • Spoilers OK, including the ending

  • Any platform (YouTube / Twitch / Niconico / X / TikTok, etc.)

  • Clips and shorts OK

  • Screenshots and captured footage may be used freely

Not permitted: redistributing the game or its data files, distributing modified builds, or presenting this game as your own work.

Free Steam keys for streaming and review are available. Contact @Para_GameStudio on X, or reach us on Discord.

data.short_description: Turn a bare rock into a neon-lit casino planet. Win chips at poker, baccarat, blackjack, chinchiro, roulette and slots, then spend them on buildings and watch the dry ground turn green. Drawn by the lights, NPCs begin to visit. Grow the liveliest planet in the galaxy, your way.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: Not Supported

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains simulated casino gambling, including poker, baccarat, blackjack, chinchiro (a Japanese dice game), slots, and roulette.
However, these are strictly simulations using in-game currency (chips). There are absolutely no real-money gambling elements, and it is impossible to wager or win real money or cryptocurrency.
Additionally, this game does not contain any depictions of violence, sexual content, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
